infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kleal uses your photos so you can set a profile picture people recognise you by at meetups.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kleal uses the camera for your profile photo and short video notes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kleal uses the microphone to record voice and video notes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kleal uses your location to suggest people within the radius you choose.
